criteria.requirement: Add humanize.percent.naturalpercent(value,*,input_unit="ratio",precision=1,rounding="half_even",group=False,space=""). Require explicit ratio/percent unit, finite int/float/Decimal excluding bool/text, 0..28 non-bool precision and half_even/half_up/down. Scale/quantize with sufficiently precise local Decimal context without float conversion or global context mutation; normalize rounded negative zero. Use actual current humanize decimal/thousands separators, optional grouping and literal percent spacing, preserving existing number formatters. Prove half-value rounding, huge finite integers/Decimal, negative/zero/out-of-unit-range values, strict options and locale output.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
